evidence.title: Chakra UI v3 Documentation for LLMs
Documentation for all components in Chakra UI v3

name: Chakra UI
summary: Accessible React component system for building web apps and design systems, installed as the @chakra-ui/react package.
description: React components covering layout and typography primitives, buttons, forms and inputs, collections, overlays, disclosure, feedback and data display, plus a charts package. The system is themeable and composable, works with Next.js RSC, and ships versioned documentation (v0 through v3) with a components index for LLMs.
contains: component groups: layout, typography, buttons, date, forms, collections, overlays, feedback, data display
charts package and date and time components
dialog, drawer, popover, tooltip, menu and toast overlays
pin input, file upload, carousel, marquee, timeline and table
LLM-readable components documentation; works with Next.js RSC
